name: 01_qubit_probabilities
caption: Qiskit calculates amplitudes and Born probabilities for all four preparations.

name: 02_measurement_histogram
caption: Sampling is finite-shot; exact theoretical probabilities are 0.5 and 0.5.

name: 03_repeated_measurement_circuit
caption: Aer simulates two measurements of one qubit; count strings display c1c0.

name: 04_gate_amplitudes
caption: H maps |+> to |0>; phase gates change relative phase in different ways.

name: 05_rotation_curve
caption: Ry(0) gives zero probability of 1; Ry(pi) gives probability 1.

name: 06_bloch_sphere
caption: Qiskit plots the prepared state; its Bloch vector has unit length.

name: 07_phase_interference
caption: Relative phase changes the final probability; the input Z-basis probabilities remain 50/50.

name: 08_toffoli_circuit
caption: Starting from 011, CCX with controls q0 and q1 produces 111 (q2q1q0).

name: 09_bell_circuit
caption: Qiskit draws q0 on the top wire; H then CX prepares the Bell state.

name: 10_entanglement_comparison
caption: For these two preparations, X-basis results reveal Bell coherence that Z-basis counts alone cannot establish.

name: 11_ghz_histogram
caption: The ideal GHZ circuit produces only 000 and 111; finite counts fluctuate.

name: 12_deutsch_results
caption: Both constant functions give q0=0; both balanced functions give q0=1 with certainty in the ideal circuit.

name: 13_deutsch_circuit
caption: The identity oracle is CX(q0,q1); the auxiliary q1 begins in |->.

name: 14_grover_results
caption: One iteration concentrates probability on 10; two return to a uniform distribution in this four-item example.

name: 15_grover_circuit
caption: The left block marks 10; the right block amplifies it through interference.

name: 16_teleportation_results
caption: All four corrected branches have fidelity 1; their sampled frequencies are near 0.25.

name: 17_teleportation_circuit
caption: Qiskit if_test blocks execute X conditioned on c1, then Z conditioned on c0.

name: 18_noise_and_purity
caption: Mixing is strongest at p=0.5. A certain flip at p=1 returns to a pure state.

name: 19_noise_histogram
caption: Sampled frequencies approach 0.8 for 0 and 0.2 for 1; they are not exact probabilities.

name: 20_coherence_comparison
caption: H maps |+> to |0>, while the maximally mixed state remains 50/50.

name: 21_transpiled_circuit
caption: The compiled circuit implements the same Bell preparation with the selected gate basis.
